confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are based on one web search of aggregated cost-of-living data for Tampa. The summary cited Numbeo's June 2026 averages: inexpensive meal about $20, mid-range three-course meal for two about $80, cappuccino about $5.81 and a draft half-litre about $7. Other aggregators were slightly lower (meal $15, cappuccino about $4.80–$5.00, beer $6), so values were blended toward the middle. Cocktail and wine prices were not searched. They were estimated from the local relationship to beer and typical US prices for a mid-sized Sun Belt city (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.6x beer), so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. No booking sites or listings were checked. Tampa has very few registered hostels, so the hostel dorm and private room values are especially uncertain. July is low-to-shoulder season in Florida, which slightly lowers hotel rates. The 1-star value reflects basic budget motels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other mid-sized Florida and Sun Belt metros such as Orlando, Jacksonville and Austin. Prices are below Miami and major coastal gateway cities, and close to the US urban average.
